newsitem.title: USA: Gannett names new Detroit News publisher.
newsitem.headline: Gannett names new Detroit News publisher.

text.p: Gannett Co said Monday that Mark Silverman will become publisher and editor of The Detroit News, replacing Robert Giles, who is scheduled to retire June 1.
Silverman is currently executive editor and vice president of news at the Courier-Journal in Louisville.
Giles, said the company, will join the Freedom Forum as senior vice president and executive director of the Media Studies Center in New York City.

Gannett is a nationwide news and information company that publishes 90 daily newspapers, including USA TODAY, and USA WEEKEND, a newspaper magazine. Gannett also operates 16 television stations, five radio stations, cable television systems in five states and alarm security services.
